title: Monitoring rapid notes & morning to-dos
content:
Morning sprint-style scratchpad for console/monitoring triage. Quickfire notes — not polished, intended as a single-day working log and TO-DO list.

2026-03-12 08:30 — checkin
- Woke up to a #obs-urgent ping: customer reported UI freezing when opening the model list in hosted console (eu-west).
- First pass: looked at Grafana alert list + recent deploys. No deploys for console in the last 24h.
- Noted spike in frontend error rates around 09:11 UTC in eu-west-1 (5xx + long response times).

Immediate triage steps (done / in-progress):
- Reproduce: open console -> Models tab -> expand model card -> see spinner (yes). (Leah)
- Check CDN / edge errors: fastly logs show increased backend timeout 504 to api.redwood-hosted in eu-west for 09:10-09:18. (Eli)
- Query logs: run quick backend query (below) to get request patterns. (Chen)

Commands / queries I ran
- kubectl -n console logs deploy/console-api --since=30m | grep "GET /v1/models" || true
- curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.eu-west.redwood.example/v1/models?limit=50" | jq '.meta'
- PromQL: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="console-api",region="eu-west"}[5m])) by (status)
- Grafana panels: Dashboard "Console - Model List" panel id=42 (slow queries).

Findings so far
- Backend call /v1/models is experiencing large p99 latencies (p99 ~ 2.8s, baseline 120ms) when response size > 20 items.
- Root cause candidate: expensive DB join introduced by recent feature flag for "model-metadata-enrichment" (PR #6621). That PR rolled out to 25% last night.
- Fastly timeouts correspond to backend slowness window.

Short-term mitigation ideas
- Roll back feature flag to 0% for eu-west by removing rollout target (Leah) — low friction and reversible.
- Add caching layer: cache list responses for 10s on API gateway (Eli) — temporary.
- Increase API replicas in eu-west for next 30 minutes to absorb traffic (Chen) — apply HPA override.

Decisions / Actions committed (timestamped)
- 09:45: disabled model-metadata-enrichment for eu-west  (Leah) — monitor.
- 09:52: opened OPS-4781 and linked PR #6621 for rollback notes. (Leah)
- 10:00: scaled console-api replicas from 4->10 in eu-west as stop-gap. (Chen)

Follow-up checks (watchlist)
- Verify p99 and error counts drop within 5–10 minutes of rollback.
- Confirm no customer cache-staleness issues (notify CS: Maya).
- Improve telemetry: add a dimension to http_request_duration_seconds for payload_size_bucket (short term). (Eli)

To-do (ordered)
- [ ] Add a lightweight unit test that simulates enriched metadata join with 200 models to catch perf regressions. (Leah)
- [x] Reproduce in staging with feature flag at 25% (checked 09:20). (Chen)
- [ ] Draft a small postmortem outline for OPS-4781 (include timeline + mitigation). (Leah)
- [ ] Add a Grafana alert for model-list p95>1s sustained for 5m in eu-west (priority P2). (Eli)
- [ ] Schedule short retro with frontend + api + db owners tomorrow 09:00 to discuss rollout gating. (All)

Notes to self / reminders
- When rolling features that add DB joins, always run the modeled explain plan and a sampling of real tenant sizes. Add a checklist item to PR template.
- Check whether the enrichment join can be offloaded to async background enrichment + eventual consistency for list endpoints. Worth prototyping (low risk).

Conversation snippets (copied from Slack for context)
- #obs-urgent @Maya: "Customer ACME sees model list hang — they tried refresh, high severity for them."
- @chen: "saw JOIN on model_versions -> metadata table — 4k rows, no index usage. suspect missing index on metadata.lookup_key."

Questions / unknowns
- Does the metadata table have multi-tenant partitioning? If not, join cost grows with number of tenants. (ask db eng)
- Any cached responses from CDN that might return stale meta? Need to coordinate invalidation TTLs.

End-of-shift handoff (if I need to step away)
- Current status: service stabilized after rollback + scale. Watching p95/p99. If error rate climbs > 50% of baseline, escalate to on-call SRE (pager ops).
- Contact: Eli Navarro (primary), Chen Wu (db help), Maya (CS liaison).

Misc scratch ideas (brain dump)
- Build a lightweight "load-smoke" harness that runs real list queries with typical tenant sizes to catch regressions in CI. Could be a small GH Actions job that samples production snapshots (anonymized).
- Consider a canary rollout rule that pins to request latency percentiles not just percent of users (e.g., keep 95th latency < X to allow rollout to proceed).

Last quick log entry 11:35: reduced p99 to 180ms after rollback+scale. Customer updated ticket with 'working now' — leave note to follow up for postmortem.

---
TO KEEP: this doc is a day scratchpad — merge relevant notes into OPS-4781 and Confluence postmortem later.
